provenance: Prototype synthetic speech rendered with Windows System.Speech.Synthesis; not archival audio.

scripts.Phase3Helmet: Look for the viewing window on the diving helmet. The window lets a diver see while keeping water out. This model is an observation aid; its exact historical provenance is not established. You can read the card and answer without holding the helmet.
scripts.Phase3Boat: Compare the fishing boat display with its explorable deck and cabin. Point at the boat and use the trigger to request boarding. Choose Enter ship or Cancel. The interior is a teaching reconstruction, not a certified vessel simulation.
scripts.Phase3FirstDay: First Day in the Harbour is a fictional port story. Select START. Read the work pass and letter, explore the harbour areas, then follow the board to find the workplace and complete a small loading task. You can retry or restart. The people and documents are interpretive reconstructions.
